Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

gambitR 0.1.0

Initial release

Core

  • gm_position(), gm_read_fen(), gm_write_fen(): position construction and FEN I/O.
  • gm_legal_moves(), gm_move(), gm_status(): legal move generation and game state.
  • gm_read_pgn(), gm_write_pgn(): PGN parsing and serialisation.
  • Move generation is verified against the published perft reference counts for the start position, Kiwipete and positions 3 to 5, so castling rights, en passant, pins and promotion are exact.

Analysis

  • gm_evaluate(): static heuristic evaluation.
  • gm_bestmove(): native alpha-beta search, with an optional UCI backend.
  • gm_uci_bestmove(): optional external engine hook (e.g. Stockfish).

Play & simulation

  • gm_play(): full game between two strategies, terminating on checkmate, stalemate, the fifty-move rule, threefold repetition, insufficient material or the move limit.
  • gm_simulate(): batch tournament simulation.

Openings & puzzles

  • gm_openings(), gm_identify_opening(): ECO opening explorer over a bundled book of 180 lines.
  • gm_puzzle(), gm_check_solution(): tactical puzzle trainer over a bundled set of 16 positions.

Visualization & app

  • gm_plot_board(), gm_plot_eval(): ggplot2 board and evaluation plots. The pieces are drawn as vector shapes rather than as text, so a board scales with the figure and renders on every device, including pdf and postscript.
  • gm_run_app(): interactive Shiny study application (Play, Analyse, Simulate, Openings, Puzzles, Study).
